rationale: A content-addressed plan may be retrieved independently of its enclosing format, so it needs a self-describing schema discriminator. The established v1alpha1 format vocabulary makes this a durable, non-metaphorical name.
alternatives: remove it and rely on the enclosing campaign format version
make it required with a constrained v1alpha1 value
simplestChoice: Keep schema_version; constrain it to the supported format value when the contract is finalized.
